summary: Blue Owl Digital Infrastructure Trust filed an 8-K reporting a routine at-the-market sale of common shares under Regulation D/S and a regular distribution declaration. On May 1, 2026, it sold 2,090,696 shares (Class S, D, I, E) for ~$21.7M at NAV per share (no premium). Gross proceeds include $133,890 of commissions. The distributions declared on May 6, 2026 are standard quarterly payments ranging from $0.0346 to $0.0417 per share, paid May 18. There is no transformational event; this is typical capital raising and dividend disclosure for a non-listed REIT. No special-situation catalyst exists.
